title: Suppressing and Slaying Gu Litian
summary: Duan De, ruined after EP100, buys his life from angry cultivators by handing over the Li City scroll. Hit by Gu Litian's Eternal Sealing Powder and nearly out of divine power, Ye Fan flees Yaoguang pursuers with Hei Huang until Weiwei, his old senior sister from the Lingxu Paradise who is now Yaoguang's 'immortal seed', saves him and gives him a pill against the poison. Gu Litian arrives to claim him, and Weiwei goads him into fighting at Ye Fan's level. When Gu Litian restores his Four Poles power mid-fight, Ye Fan uses his attacks to refine source faster and breaks into Dao Palace Level 4, opening his Spleen Divine Treasury. Gu Litian answers with his Water Dragon body and the Nine Water Dragon Transformation, but Ye Fan shows him the Holy Body's human strength and kills him. Ye Fan names him the first of Yaoguang's ten young masters to die.
